correctness.rationale: A period-two return on a connected graph forces all vertices to fire once per two rounds; the two phase firing sets are complementary. For a prescribed phase cut, local threshold inequalities supply exactly c_v independent nonnegative chip heights at each vertex and hence the product of cross-cut degrees. The exact 16-state transfer enumerates all such cuts on either cubic closure by ordinary or row-exchange-twisted trace. It commutes with row swap and its plus/minus characteristic polynomials were recomputed symbolically from actual supplied code, yielding the stated recurrence sums for every n >= 3. An independent C++ graph-adjacency enumeration confirms each n=3,...,10, and fully constructs/iterates every counted two-cycle configuration for n=3,4; finite tests corroborate the algebra, not replace it. The parity and asymptotic conclusions follow from explicit real quadratic roots.
